name: Disable dynamic app icon
description: Prevents Duolingo from changing the app icon. Only the default icon will be available.

name: Enable Premium
description: Enables app features locked behind the subscription paywall. Some features like AI video calls may not work.

options.title: Type
options.description: Choose which type of premium Duolingo subscription to enable.

name: Enable debug mode
description: Enables hidden debug menu in settings.

name: Unlimited RampUp time
description: The timer for RampUp challenges will never decrease.
